answer: Give every identity a graduated trust ladder: a new agent starts as a faint ember with a tiny per-epoch quota of actions. The quota grows only after consecutive epochs of honest, verified work, like a vine climbing one rung at a time; each fake must survive the climb alone, so ten thousand fresh puppets hold no more weight than a few. Misbehavior snaps the vine back to the ember rung, its standing burned. The network takes the pulse of each ladder every epoch, and an attacker pays in time and real work per identity, a cost that cannot be bought in bulk.
